declared_purpose: Provide a configurable framework for trading and monitoring Polymarket 5-minute and 15-minute crypto markets using CEX momentum signals through Simmer. Market discovery, import and execution support this purpose; the user controls scheduling. Detailed signal reporting, automatic redemption and journal integration are implementation choices rather than explicit entry-document requirements. Sources: SKILL.md:2–16,37–41,67–90,189–198; DISCLAIMER.md:3–4.

data_operations.operation: Solicit credentials and instruct environment storage
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Setup assistant and operator environment; conversation retention is unspecified
data_operations.condition: Setup requests the API key and describes the wallet key as required for live trading. Package metadata narrows the wallet-key requirement to external-wallet self-custody and excludes managed wallets.

data_operations.operation: Load configuration and delegate configuration updates
data_operations.source: Configuration schema, packaged config.json, environment and CLI arguments
data_operations.data_scope: Trading thresholds, asset, window, sizing, budget, signal and guard settings
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local process and simmer_sdk.skill helpers; update storage behavior is unavailable
data_operations.condition: Configuration loads at module import. --set validates recognized keys, calls update_config and prints updates. --config prints settings and the helper-returned path, then returns before client initialization.

data_operations.operation: Read and overwrite daily budget state
data_operations.source: Local daily_spend.json and successful trade results
data_operations.data_scope: UTC date, aggregate amount spent and trade count
data_operations.condition: Every strategy invocation reads current-day state if present. A successful result marked nonsimulated updates and overwrites the file. An old date resets the in-memory counters; the old file remains until a later write. No deletion routine is shown.

data_operations.operation: Read an API credential and initialize the SDK client
data_operations.data_scope: API credential, venue selection and live/paper flag
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: In-process SimmerClient singleton; SDK authentication transport is unavailable
data_operations.condition: Normal strategy execution initializes the client after the configuration-only return. The main path passes live=False by default and live=True with --live. TRADING_VENUE can override the documented Polymarket default. The packaged Python code does not directly read WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY.

data_operations.operation: Discover markets through Simmer, with direct Gamma fallback
data_operations.source: Configured asset/window and remote market inventories
data_operations.data_scope: Simmer request: asset, window and limit=50. Gamma request: up to 100 unclosed crypto markets ordered by end date; matching asset/window filtering occurs locally.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: SimmerClient.get_fast_markets; fallback HTTPS GET to gamma-api.polymarket.com/markets/keyset; responses remain with the strategy caller
data_operations.condition: Normal trading cycle. Gamma runs when Simmer produces no live markets, including after failure. This differs from the entry document's direct-Polymarket description. Direct HTTP requests include the skill User-Agent and no supplied credential header.

data_operations.source: Configured asset symbol, lookback and current time
data_operations.data_scope: Symbol, interval and timestamp range sent to Simmer; fallback symbol, interval=1m and candle limit sent to Binance
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: SimmerClient.get_candles; live-environment fallback to api.binance.com/api/v3/klines, then api.binance.us/api/v3/klines if needed
data_operations.condition: Binance signal path first tries Simmer's data plane. Direct requests occur only outside SIMMER_REPLAY=1 when the plane is unavailable or insufficient. Replay fails closed. The coingecko option only prints guidance and returns no signal; it makes no CoinGecko request.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve an additional market-open reference price
data_operations.source: Selected market end time, window duration and asset symbol
data_operations.data_scope: Symbol and two-minute reference range to Simmer; fallback symbol, startTime, interval=1m and limit=1 to Binance
data_operations.condition: Fair-value mode with a known market end time. Direct Binance fallback is blocked during replay.

data_operations.operation: Retrieve public token prices, fees and order-book data
data_operations.data_scope: YES token_id in URL queries; returned midpoint, fee rate and book levels
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: clob.polymarket.com/fee-rate, /midpoint and /book; results are processed locally
data_operations.condition: Fee lookup uses a sample market when its fee rate is missing. Midpoint is required for the selected market. Book retrieval occurs when Simmer supplied no spread. Missing midpoint or required book causes a skip.

data_operations.operation: Infer market signals and strategy attributes
data_operations.source: Retrieved candles, market odds, configured volatility and time remaining
data_operations.data_scope: Momentum, direction, volume ratio, optional fair value, edge, trade rationale and confidence
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local strategy process; selected derived fields later cross the trade, journal and stdout boundaries described below
data_operations.condition: After usable signal data arrives; fair-value calculations require the optional mode and reference price. These are market/strategy inferences, not demonstrated personal-attribute inferences.

data_operations.operation: Read positions and classify/filter them locally
data_operations.data_scope: All returned position objects converted to dictionaries; monitoring uses question, YES/NO shares and P&L; deduplication uses market ID/question and holdings
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: SDK return to local caller; matching monitoring fields can be printed to stdout
data_operations.condition: --positions filters questions containing 'up or down'. A trading cycle instead reads positions to avoid buying an already-held selected market. No onward disclosure of the complete position response is shown.

data_operations.operation: Read portfolio summaries for balance display and sizing
data_operations.data_scope: Returned portfolio summary; only balance_usdc is consumed by these paths
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Local strategy caller; displayed balance goes to stdout
data_operations.condition: --smart-sizing reads a summary before discovery and reads another when an eligible signal reaches sizing. Sizing uses 5% of balance, capped by the configured maximum.

data_operations.operation: Invoke redemption and live balance checks before mode-specific work
data_operations.source: Initialized SDK client and account state
data_operations.data_scope: Unfiltered auto_redeem invocation and returned market IDs/sides; ensure_can_trade returns balance, collateral, reason and safe size
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Simmer SDK/account boundary; selected results are printed locally
data_operations.condition: auto_redeem is called in both paper and live modes, including --positions. ensure_can_trade runs only live and can return before positions display. Actual redemption and paper-mode effects depend on the unavailable SDK.

data_operations.operation: Read open orders, infer ownership and request cancellations
data_operations.data_scope: Returned orders, source, skill_slug, question and order identifier
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: Order list returns to the local caller; selected order IDs go to SimmerClient.cancel_order
data_operations.condition: Live GTC execution after successful balance checks, including --live --positions. An order is treated as belonging to this skill when source matches, slug matches, or its question contains 'up or down'. Cancellation is an account mutation, not evidence of data-record deletion.

data_operations.operation: Import a selected market or retrieve market details
data_operations.source: Selected Gamma slug or caller-supplied market ID
data_operations.data_scope: Polymarket event URL for import; market ID for details and returned market object
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: SimmerClient.import_market or get_market_by_id; responses return to the caller
data_operations.condition: Import runs only after a qualifying signal when the selected market lacks a Simmer ID. get_market_details is a defined helper with no packaged CLI call site.

data_operations.operation: Run execution preflight and optional news matching
data_operations.source: Planned amount, client venue, selected market context and SDK news schedule loader
data_operations.data_scope: Preflight receives planned_amount, exposure_cap_usd=0 and venue. News matching receives market ID/question/slug and a loaded schedule.
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: SimmerClient.preflight and imported SDK guard functions; schedule source, transport and persistence are unknown
data_operations.condition: Preflight runs only when client.live is true. The default-off news veto is checked before execute_trade and again inside it; a match blocks order placement. Guard returns and blocker details can reach stdout.

data_operations.operation: Submit an order with strategy metadata
data_operations.source: Selected market, decision, position size and inferred signal
data_operations.data_scope: market_id, side, amount, order_type, source, skill_slug and signal_data containing edge, confidence, signal_source, market_price, window_minutes and optional fair_value
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: SimmerClient.trade; documented execution through Simmer to Polymarket, with exact SDK serialization and retention unavailable
data_operations.condition: After strategy, budget, import and applicable guards pass. The default CLI path also calls trade with a paper client, despite documentation describing dry-run as no execution. Nonsimulated success triggers budget persistence; exact simulation behavior is external.

data_operations.operation: Hand successful live-trade details to an optional journal component
data_operations.source: Trade result and locally inferred strategy data
data_operations.data_scope: Trade ID, source, skill slug, rationale, confidence, asset, momentum percentage, volume ratio and signal source
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: tradejournal.log_trade or skills.tradejournal.log_trade; actual storage and any remote recipient are unknown
data_operations.condition: A journal module imports successfully and a successful nonsimulated result contains a trade ID. Import availability automatically enables the handoff; absent modules use a no-op.

data_operations.operation: Emit human-readable and structured execution output
data_operations.source: Configuration, budget/account responses, market signals, trade results and errors
data_operations.data_scope: Settings, balances, position shares/P&L, selected markets, rationale, sizing, outcomes and error strings; managed reports add counts, amounts and some failure details
data_operations.recipient_or_storage: stdout to the invoking caller; no separate network sink is implemented
data_operations.condition: Routine logs respect --quiet, but forced trade/error/balance messages and AUTOMATON_MANAGED reports can still print. The documented OpenClaw cron template requests an output summary and --announce; its audience and retention are unspecified.

potential_excess.data_scope: WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY solicited under the blanket live-trading setup instruction
potential_excess.condition: Following SKILL.md setup for a managed-wallet user
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Signing is relevant to external-wallet self-custody; clawhub.json explicitly says managed wallets do not require this key.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Authenticate to Simmer and obtain signing capability only when the chosen wallet requires it.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Determine wallet mode before requesting the key; omit it for managed wallets and direct external-wallet users to configure it locally without conversational disclosure.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep external-wallet signing available; the SDK's actual signing requirements remain unverified.

potential_excess.data_scope: Complete returned venue-position objects and positions unrelated to the selected market or requested fast-market view
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: SDK response into the local strategy process
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Deduplication needs selected-market identity and holdings; monitoring needs matching fast-market question, holdings and P&L.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Perform the position read needed for the requested decision or view.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: If supported, filter at retrieval by selected market or fast-market scope and request only consumed fields. Otherwise retain only a minimal local projection.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve complete matching coverage, including the question fallback when a Gamma market lacks a Simmer ID. SDK filtering/projection support is unknown. This is extra scope within a required read, not proof of onward disclosure.

potential_excess.data_scope: A second portfolio-summary response within one smart-sizing cycle
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: SimmerClient.get_portfolio return to the local caller
potential_excess.condition: --smart-sizing reaches eligible trade sizing after the earlier portfolio display
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Both calls consume only balance_usdc for display or sizing.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Obtain a sufficiently current balance for capped 5% sizing and display it.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use one balance read at sizing time for both calculation and display.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Maintain required balance freshness; refresh only when account changes justify it. This removes a redundant action rather than merely removing fields.

potential_excess.data_scope: Portfolio-summary fields beyond balance_usdc, if returned
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Required smart-sizing SDK read into the local process
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The implementation uses only the balance field.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Read the balance used for sizing.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Use a balance-only endpoint or field projection if the SDK provides one.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve the same balance semantics and error fallback. The supplied source does not identify the summary's additional fields or establish that a narrower API exists. This concerns extra data within the remaining required read.

potential_excess.data_scope: Derived edge, confidence, signal source, observed price, lookback and optional fair value
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: signal_data argument at the SimmerClient.trade boundary; downstream transmission/retention is unresolved
potential_excess.condition: Every qualifying paper or live trade submission
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Order execution and documented strategy attribution require order inputs and source tags; the entry document does not require detailed signal disclosure.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Submit the selected order while preserving source and skill attribution.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Make detailed signal reporting opt-in or omit fields not required by the SDK execution contract.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Verify SDK acceptance and preserve any explicitly requested analytics. This is additional metadata in a required trade action, not a redundant trade.

potential_excess.data_scope: Successful trade identifier plus rationale, confidence and detailed signal attributes
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Optional tradejournal.log_trade or skills.tradejournal.log_trade component; persistence destination unknown
potential_excess.condition: Journal import succeeds and a successful nonsimulated trade has a trade ID
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Journal integration is ancillary to the declared trading framework and is already bypassed when unavailable.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Execute and attribute trades and maintain the daily aggregate budget.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Require explicit journal opt-in and permit a minimal record instead of automatically forwarding the full payload.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep full journaling available when requested. Removing this ancillary handoff preserves the implemented no-journal trading path; no remote journal transmission is proven.

potential_excess.data_scope: Orders from other strategies inferred to belong to this skill solely from 'up or down' in their question
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Local ownership classification and order IDs submitted to SimmerClient.cancel_order
potential_excess.condition: Live GTC cleanup encounters such orders, including during --live --positions
potential_excess.purpose_basis: Cleanup explicitly intends to cancel this skill's stale orders, and documented source tagging promises isolation from other skills.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Identify and cancel stale orders actually owned by this skill.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Require matching source or skill_slug; use verified provenance for legacy orders instead of the generic question pattern. Apply retrieval filters if supported.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Preserve cleanup of verified own orders and provide a deliberate legacy-order path. Cancellation changes order state; it is not demonstrated deletion of stored trading data.

potential_excess.data_scope: Redemption invocation, live wallet-balance checks and open-order cleanup preceding a positions-only request
potential_excess.recipient_or_storage: Simmer SDK/account boundary; returned account details may reach stdout
potential_excess.condition: --positions reaches account initialization; balance checks and cleanup additionally require live mode and applicable order settings
potential_excess.purpose_basis: The CLI describes --positions as showing current fast-market positions.
potential_excess.necessary_behavior: Retrieve and display the requested positions.
potential_excess.proposed_reduction: Handle positions-only mode before trading maintenance, balance checks and cancellation logic.
potential_excess.preservation_conditions: Keep maintenance on trading cycles or a separately requested maintenance path. Actual redemption effects depend on the unavailable SDK. These are additional actions for monitoring, not extra fields in the position read.

unknowns: simmer-sdk is not packaged. Its exact endpoints, authentication handling, request serialization, account-response fields, remote persistence, onward disclosures and live/paper side effects remain unresolved. Observed SDK calls do not establish their complete external behavior.
The entry document claims client-side wallet signing, but the signing implementation is absent. Whether and how WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY is consumed or transmitted cannot be verified.
Configuration helper storage paths, environment precedence implementation and any helper side effects cannot be verified from the imported interfaces alone.
The journal implementations are absent. Their storage location, remote recipients, retention, deletion and import-time behavior are unknown.
The news schedule loader and matcher are absent. Schedule origin, local versus remote access, caching and the freshness requirements of the two checks are unknown.
Caller handling of stdout, cron logs and OpenClaw --announce recipients and retention are unspecified. Ordinary stdout and SDK returns are not evidence of disclosure to an additional recipient.

Packaged tests use synthetic inputs, SDK stubs and mocked calls; they do not resolve production dependency behavior. The supplied implementation shows no general credential, journal or remote-record deletion mechanism.
